channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — Business
channel.description: Latest Business stories from BusinessHub.cy, Cyprus Edition.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Group MSC
item.description: President Christodoulides met with MSC Group CFO Alexa Aponte Vago to discuss the shipping giant's ongoing operations and strategic presence in Cyprus.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Inauguration of the new premises of “Ethnikos Assias” Association
item.description: President Christodoulides inaugurated the new premises of the Ethnikos Assias Association in Strovolos, signaling continued state support for refugee-linked community organizations.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – 47th CIM-Cyprus Business School Graduation Ceremony
item.description: President Christodoulides addressed the 47th graduation ceremony of CIM-Cyprus Business School, highlighting the role of specialized education in driving the national economy.

item.title: Road Freight Transport - Freight transport in Cyprus +2,3% and from and to Cyprus +17,7% (2nd Quarter 2026)
item.description: Cyprus road freight transport grew in Q2 2026, with a significant 17.7% surge in international cargo alongside a modest 2.3% rise in domestic movement.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – 13th annual memorial service of the former President of the...
item.description: President Nikos Christodoulides attended the 13th annual memorial service for former President Glafcos Clerides at the Apostolos Varnavas Cathedral in Nicosia.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Cyprus Universities Rectors’ Conference
item.description: President Christodoulides met with the Cyprus Universities Rectors’ Conference to discuss strategic developments in higher education and the sector's role in the national economy.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Cyprus Property Developers Association
item.description: President Nikos Christodoulides met with the Cyprus Property Developers Association to discuss strategic challenges and legislative reforms in the real estate sector.

item.title: AbleBook’s Andreas Vasiliou Takes On His First Marathon as Community Team Runs and Rolls for Inclusion
item.description: AbleBook, Stoiximan Wheels of Change and Yparxo opened their 5 km Corporate Race team to the public, while Vasiliou and teammate Marios Antonios Marshall lined up for their first full marathon in Larnaka.

item.title: Economist 22nd Annual Cyprus Summit Panagiotou
item.description: The Economist 22nd Annual Cyprus Summit, scheduled for November 2026, will address regional cooperation, geopolitics, and investment opportunities in Nicosia.

item.title: OEB promotes Hydrogen Valleys in Cyprus
item.description: OEB participates in the EU-funded TRIERES project to develop Green Hydrogen Valleys, aiming to transfer technical expertise and sustainable energy infrastructure models to Cyprus.

item.title: Media advisory - Foreign Affairs Council of 16 November 2026
item.description: EU Foreign Ministers will meet on November 16 to discuss winter support for Ukraine and counter-measures against Russian hybrid threats affecting member states.

item.title: Infocredit Group’s ComplianceSuite wins Gold for Best Compliance Platform
item.description: The Cyprus-developed platform, recognised at the 2026 Compliance Awards, brings customer onboarding, AML screening, transaction monitoring and case management into one workflow.

item.title: Nepal Stabilizes Its Economy—and Sets Its Sights Higher
item.description: Nepal has achieved macroeconomic stability through structural reforms, shifting focus toward accelerating inclusive growth and long-term economic resilience.

item.title: IMF Staff Reaches Staff Level Agreement with Armenia on the Second Review of the Stand-By Arrangement (SBA) and request for a Resilience and Sustainability Facility (RSF)
item.description: The IMF reaches a staff-level agreement with Armenia, potentially unlocking significant financial support and enhancing regional economic stability.

item.title: IMF Staff Concludes Visit to Lebanon
item.description: IMF staff visited Lebanon to advance banking sector restructuring, but a final agreement remains pending as laws must align with international standards to ensure financial stability.

item.title: Pavlos Phokas calls for a stronger role for Cyprus shipyards in defence programmes
item.description: Multimarine Services’ Chief Commercial Officer highlighted how local shipyards and marine engineering firms could support Cyprus’ Ministry of Defence and help turn defence investment into skilled jobs.

item.title: EU economy greenhouse gas emissions: -0.5% in Q2 2026
item.description: EU greenhouse gas emissions declined by 0.5% in Q2 2026 despite economic activity, highlighting a continued trend toward decoupling growth from environmental impact.

item.title: EU consumption expenditure grows, alcohol & tobacco dip
item.description: Eurostat data reveals a rise in overall EU household consumption expenditure, contrasting with a decline in spending on alcohol and tobacco products.

item.title: Ablebook co-founders present app for finding accessible places across Cyprus
item.description: Andreas Vasiliou and Symeon Stylianou presented Ablebook, a Cyprus-developed app that helps people with disabilities check venue facilities, find designated parking and plan visits in advance.

item.title: ASBIS joins “From Grant to Growth” panel at Plug and Play Cyprus Expo
item.description: As a founding corporate partner ASBIS supported the Plug and Play Cyprus Expo alongside Mastercard, Tototheo Global and ECOMMBX. The Expo took place on November 11 at Etko in Limassol and marked the completion of the first cohort of the Plug and Play Cyprus Acceleration Program, with 10 startups…

item.title: GDP Growth Rate - Growth Rate 3,1% (seasonally adjusted) - 3rd Quarter 2026 (Flash Estimate)
item.description: Cyprus GDP grew by 3.1% in Q3 2026, signaling sustained economic resilience and outperforming the broader Eurozone average.

item.title: Call Centre Cyprus wins Gold for Sophia for Children partnership
item.description: The initiative reactivated 64 sponsors and generated €5,220 in donations, helping 64 children continue receiving support through the Adopt a Child programme

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Informal meeting of EU Heads of State or Government
item.description: President Christodoulides participated in an informal EU summit in Dublin to discuss strategic European priorities and regional stability.

item.title: Interior Minister – President and delegation of Ammochostos Chamber of Commerce and Industry
item.description: Interior Minister Constantinos Ioannou met with the Ammochostos Chamber of Commerce and Industry to discuss regional development and local governance issues.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – EPC Summit 2026
item.description: President Nikos Christodoulides attends the 2026 European Political Community Summit in Dublin to engage in high-level discussions on regional security and political cooperation.

item.title: Deputy Minister to the President – CCCI and CSO
item.description: Deputy Minister Irene Piki met with CCCI and CSO representatives to discuss the intersection of business interests and sports development in Cyprus.

item.title: Interior Minister – Coordinating Committee of Keryneia’s Associations and Organisations
item.description: Interior Minister Constantinos Ioannou met with Keryneia district representatives to discuss refugee-related issues and local administration concerns.

item.title: Value of agriculture output hits record high in 2025
item.description: The EU agricultural industry reached a record output value of €537.1 billion in 2025, driven by price increases despite fluctuating production volumes.

item.title: 2.3 million tonnes of textile waste generated in 2024
item.description: The EU produced 2.3 million tonnes of textile waste in 2024, signaling urgent regulatory shifts toward circular economy practices and mandatory collection across member states.

item.title: Emergency oil stocks slightly down; commercial stocks up in July 2026
item.description: July 2026 data shows a slight decline in EU emergency oil stocks, partially offset by an increase in commercial reserves.

item.title: Deputy Minister of Culture – Press conference
item.description: The Deputy Ministry of Culture has unveiled a new grant scheme specifically designed to fund and support publications focusing on Cypriot culture.

item.title: Commissioner for Administration and the Protection of Human Rights – Regional Conference
item.description: Cyprus celebrates the 35th anniversary of the Ombudsman institution, highlighting its role in human rights protection and administrative accountability within the Republic.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – UN Climate Change Conference COP31
item.description: President Christodoulides represents Cyprus at COP31 in Antalya, focusing on regional climate resilience and international environmental policy alignment.

item.title: Interior Minister – General Assembly of the "Nicosia – Capital of Cyprus" Initiative
item.description: Interior Minister Constantinos Ioannou addressed the General Assembly of the 'Nicosia – Capital of Cyprus' initiative, focusing on the city's strategic development and administrative role.

item.title: Deputy Minister to the President – High Commissioner of the Commonwealth of Australia to the Republic of Cyprus
item.description: Deputy Minister Irene Piki met with Australian High Commissioner Emily Louise Pugin to discuss strengthening bilateral relations and diplomatic cooperation between Cyprus and Australia.

item.title: Women made up 41% of EU scientists & engineers in 2025
item.description: Eurostat data reveals women now represent 41% of the EU's 15.3 million scientists and engineers, highlighting a steady trend toward gender parity in technical sectors.

item.title: Temporary protection for 4.37 million in September 2026
item.description: As of September 2026, 4.37 million Ukrainians benefit from EU temporary protection, with Cyprus hosting 20,495 individuals, reflecting a steady labor pool and social service demand.

item.title: Foreign direct investment: where is it coming from?
item.description: Eurostat data highlights the dominance of the US and UK in EU foreign direct investment, signaling critical trends for Cyprus as an international financial hub.

item.title: Almost 30% unable to cope with unexpected expenses
item.description: Eurostat data reveals nearly 30% of the EU population lacks the financial reserves to handle unexpected expenses, highlighting significant household financial vulnerability.

item.title: Deputy Minister of Culture – “Culture boxes” handover ceremony
item.description: The Deputy Ministry of Culture launched the 'Culture Boxes' initiative to foster artistic engagement and cultural identity among primary school students through the Cultural Ambassadors programme.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Vice President of Global Exploration at ExxonMobil
item.description: President Christodoulides met with ExxonMobil's VP of Global Exploration to discuss the energy giant's ongoing activities and future commitment to the Cyprus Exclusive Economic Zone.

item.title: Interior Minister – Presidents of Community Councils of Larnaka District
item.description: Interior Minister Constantinos Ioannou met with Larnaka Community Council Presidents in Kivisili to discuss local governance issues and regional development within the district.

item.title: Transport Minister – Signing ceremony for Lefkosia Ring Road – Phase C
item.description: The Cyprus Minister of Transport has signed the contract for Phase C of the Nicosia Ring Road, advancing a critical infrastructure project to alleviate capital traffic congestion.

item.title: New automated notification service for applications and residence documents
item.description: The Migration Department has launched a new automated SMS and email notification system for residence applications and document expiries, requiring a CY Login account.

item.title: Are EU house prices outpacing income?
item.description: Eurostat data reveals a widening gap between EU house prices and disposable income, signaling housing affordability challenges across the bloc since 2010.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Economists Enterprise’s 22nd Annual Cyprus Summit
item.description: President Christodoulides addressed the 22nd Annual Economist Cyprus Summit, reinforcing the government's commitment to fiscal stability and structural reforms to attract foreign investment.

item.title: President of the Republic of Cyprus – Joint meeting with the Personal Envoy of the UN Secretary-General and the leader of the Turkish Cypriot community
item.description: President Christodoulides met with the UN Personal Envoy and the Turkish Cypriot leader in Nicosia, signaling a potential revival of formal diplomatic discussions.

item.title: Interior Minister – Presentation of the Ministry’s budget for the year 2027
item.description: Interior Minister Constantinos Ioannou presented the 2027 Ministry budget to the House Financial Committee, outlining future state spending on local government and housing.

item.title: CY-Alert test notifications on 10 November 2026, between 11:00 and 15:00
item.description: Cyprus will test the CY-Alert public warning system on November 10, 2026, as part of a Mediterranean-wide tsunami simulation exercise.

item.title: Announcement of the Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Cyprus on the resumption of the National Solidary Fund's electronic service...
item.description: The Ministry of Finance has reopened the electronic portal for the National Solidarity Fund, allowing 2013 haircut victims who missed the first deadline to register for compensation.
